kurzbeschreibung: The **Außerfern** is the northwesternmost region of **Tirol** – a landscape of lakes and mountains with views of the **Zugspitze**, the wild **Lech** river, and picturesque villages.
beschreibung: The **Außerfern** (Reutte district) is the only part of Tirol north of the main Alpine ridge and is nestled between the Allgäu and Lechtal Alps. The region is defined by the deep **Lechschlucht**, the clear **Plansee**, and bizarre rock formations. The main town, **Reutte**, is famous for Schloss Ehrenberg with Austria’s longest suspension bridge, the **Highline179**. **Ehrwald** lies right on the German border and serves as the starting point for hikes to the **Zugspitze**, Germany’s highest mountain. **Lermoos** and **Berwang** are popular year-round destinations, offering stunning views of the **Zugspitze**.
tipps: Die Highline179 bei Reutte ist die längste Fußgänger-Hängebrücke Österreichs – Eintritt frei!
Der Plansee ist einer der saubersten Seen Tirols – ideal zum Baden und Stand-up-Paddling.
Die Zugspitzarena in Ehrwald bietet ein familienfreundliches Skigebiet mit Panoramabahn.
empfehlungen: Our tip: Hike through the Lechschlucht near Reutte – a spectacular waterway flanked by steep cliffs. Afterwards, visit the Highline179 for a breathtaking view over the Ehrenberg castle ruins.
umgebung: The **Außerfern** borders **Bayern** (Germany) to the north and **Vorarlberg** to the west. To the east lies the **Lechtal** (also part of the **Außerfern**), while the **Alpenhauptkamm** separates it from the rest of **Nordtirol** to the south. Nearby larger cities include **Garmisch-Partenkirchen** (D) and **Imst**.
